answer: An agent economy can defeat self-dealing Sybils with multilateral netting. Deals in each period are netted together, so fakes that only trade among themselves net to zero: however busy the fable of their market looks, no net value leaves the closed cluster. Only trades with independent outsiders create a real balance, a pearl earned from genuine exchange. A violet flag marks closed trade graphs, and their claims are cancelled before payout. An attacker must win real business from strangers for every fake identity, paying cost per Sybil instead of minting profit by shuffling value in a circle.
